# LaddoThis

> iPhone app for planning South Asian weddings (App Store name: "LaddoThis: Indian Weddings"). Ready-made, ceremony-by-ceremony checklists for 28 communities, with budget, vendor and gift tracking and e-card invitations.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759238184
- Ceremony guides: https://coderalert0.github.io/laddothis-site/guides/
- Support and privacy policy: https://coderalert0.github.io/laddothis-site/

## Facts
- Platform: iPhone (iOS).
- Communities: Sikh Punjabi, Hindu Punjabi, Pakistani (Punjabi Muslim), Muhajir (Urdu-speaking Pakistani), Sindhi Muslim, Saraiki, Pashtun, Balochi, Indian Muslim (North Indian), Kashmiri Muslim, Ismaili, Gujarati Hindu, Tamil Hindu, Telugu Hindu, Bengali Hindu, Marathi (Maharashtrian Hindu), Malayali Hindu (Kerala), Kannada Hindu, Rajasthani Marwari, Sindhi Hindu, Kashmiri Pandit, Odia Hindu, Assamese Hindu, Indo-Caribbean Hindu, Jain, Parsi, Kerala Christian, Goan Catholic.
- 397 ceremonies in all, each a ready-made checklist with tasks for the bride's side and the groom's side, things to buy, and reminders for when to start.
- Also: budget tracker with community-typical categories, vendor contacts, gift tracker, photo inspiration board, wedding-day countdown and timeline.
- E-card invitations for Save the Date, Jaggo, Sangeet, Mehndi, Anand Karaj, Nikah, Walima, Maticoor, the wedding ceremony and the reception, matched to the community.
- Pricing: free download; one-time purchase unlocks everything; Apple Family Sharing covers up to 5 family members. No subscriptions, no ads; data stays on the device.
